item.description:
When: Thursday 29 October 2026, 20:00
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

October's build is OpenAI's Codex, one of the leading AI coding agents. If you've heard people talk about AI writing code for them and wondered what that actually looks like in practice, this is your chance to try it yourself.
